added.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Staff AI Platform Engineer to build the shared platform that lets people across the company build and run AI-powered tools safely and quickly. As a hands-on senior individual contributor, you will help design the application runtime, knowledge systems, agent infrastructure, and governance tooling that teams would otherwise build separately, and you will help set the patterns other engineers follow. Your work spans product R&D, design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis. It draws on data from our battery test stands, factory manufacturing robots, and deployed projects in the field, along with the documents, slide decks, transcripts, and conversations our teams produce every day. You will sit on the AI & Data Platform team, working with data engineers, software engineers, Information Security, and the scientists, engineers, and operators who use what you build. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission puts AI to work.

This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from our office in Berkeley, CA, Somerville, MA or Weirton, WV 3+ days per week.

Relocation assistance is available.

What You'll Do

Build and operate the internal application platform that lets employees create and deploy AI-generated applications on curated backend and frontend frameworks, with starter templates, design guidance, authentication, and secure deployment built in, so app authors own only business logic, user flows, and UI.
Give those applications governed access to data, including connectivity to our data warehouse and a shared Postgres cluster for application state that is automatically integrated into our data platform.
Build and operate a central knowledge platform over unstructured content (documents, slide decks, meeting transcripts, Slack) and structured data from battery test stands, manufacturing robots, and deployed systems, pairing document retrieval with query access to structured data through semantic models and text-to-SQL. Own its retrieval quality through semantic and hybrid search, re-ranking, chunking, and classification, with source-level permissions and evaluation sets that show whether a change helps.
Design and deploy the shared MCP infrastructure, including a gateway layer (such as agentgateway) for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging, and build MCP servers for applications and services across the software org and for selected external tools.
Own model selection and cost: evaluate open-source and open-weight models against frontier models on our own tasks, decide where each fits, and reduce token usage through context management, caching, and model routing.
Build the agent orchestration layer, including multi-agent workflows and long-running loops with checkpoints, human review gates, and automated evaluation. Work with data engineers to decide when work should run as a deterministic, scheduled workflow and when it needs a graph or state machine in which an agent chooses among bounded steps.
Partner with product R&D, battery design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis teams to find repeatable work and automate it, including agent workflows whose output informs critical design and process decisions.
Instrument the platform with tracing, evaluation, and usage and cost attribution by team, and stand up the AWS infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi and/or Terraform) it runs on.
Help stand up a company-wide skills and plugin marketplace that vets contributions against AI policy and scans them for security vulnerabilities with open-source and commercial tools. Advise on AI governance, recommending changes that make the policy specific to platform needs and automating its execution, such as approvals for new tools.
Raise the engineering bar through design docs and RFCs, code review, mentorship, and technical influence that reaches beyond the immediate team.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related field plus 7+ years of software or data engineering experience, including building and operating production platforms or services that other engineers depend on.
Strong production programming in Python and Go, with experience building APIs and backend services.
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems in production, including retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, and structured-data access through text-to-SQL or semantic layers.
Experience with agent frameworks, tool calling, and the Model Context Protocol, and with workflow orchestration or state-machine frameworks such as LangGraph, Temporal, or Dagster.
Experience building evaluation sets and harnesses for LLM systems and measuring quality, latency, and cost across model providers, including open-weight models.
Experience with PostgreSQL and a cloud data warehouse, plus AWS, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code with Pulumi and/or Terraform.
Working knowledge of platform and AI security: authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), secrets management, sandboxed execution, tenant isolation, supply-chain scanning, and risks specific to LLM tools such as prompt injection and data exfiltration.
A track record of building internal platforms that other teams adopt, and of independently leading the design of novel solutions through technical design docs and RFCs.
Excellent communication and organizational skills, including with scientists, engineers, and operators who aren't software developers, and comfort participating in an on-call rotation.
Nice to have: React and design-system experience; Snowflake or Databricks; serving open-weight models (for example with vLLM); API or AI gateway experience; AI governance or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001); background in battery, energy, manufacturing, or other physical-systems data.

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.

If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never
solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

Embed with the teams you serve — across R&D, manufacturing, field and commercial operations, and the functions that support them — to understand their hardest problems firsthand, then design and build the software that solves them.

added.title: AI/ML Driven ASIC Design and Implementation Automation Engineer
added.description:
As an AI/ML driven ASIC Design and Implementation Automation Engineer
in our Advanced Chip Engineering (ACE) organization, you will work in a dynamic environment to explore methodology, flows and tools to improve efficiency and quality of results (power, performance, area, and quality) for SoC and IP development teams across the organization. You'll be working and connecting with AI/ML and automation experts in the industry as well as academia to explore state-of-the-art AI/ML CAD techniques as a part of VLSI CAD SW, prescribe key methods and requirements for tools & features to leverage for ASIC design.

In this role, you will develop prototype solutions to evaluate various state-of-the-art AI/ML techniques to identify the best solutions for NXP designs. While exploring these new ways of working, successful candidates will be working on actual designs and implementation to pilot and develop the automation.

This opportunity is within ACE Design Methodologies and Automation organization to enable transformation to leverage state-of-the-art AI/ML ideas to improve NXP designs for the Automotive Processors and Advanced microcontrollers in NXP.

The right candidate will be working in a fast-paced engineering environment, on a leading-edge advanced node technologies enabling automated building of exciting and complex SoCs.

Job Summary

Explore research ideas and solutions that bring AI/ML applications to VLSI design
Work closely with Academic research communities in AI/ML for VLSI design, Architecture teams, IP and SoC designers and SoC Implementation teams from multiple sites to explore and evaluate for leading edge SoC technologies serving multiple industries
These automation applications include use of GenAI, Reinforcement Learning, Graph Neural Networks, and convolutional Networks
Strong AI/ML expertise, software and CAD background required

Cross Functional Aspects

In this role, the candidate will work with multiple NXP Engineering teams, including Architecture, IP & SoC design, verification and implementation functions, coordinate and drive groundbreaking initiatives for Digital Transformation.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related disciplines with strong background in SW development
Hands-on expertise in programming using Python/C++
5+ years of experience in AI and ML techniques (LLMs, CNN, RNN, and GraphNN) with experience of application to real world optimization problems
Data structures, algorithms, and SW development for optimization problems
Hands on experience in Unix/Linux, revision control (Git, BitBucket), SW development and debug tools
Excellent analytical problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Desirable Skills/experience

Strong understanding of design, layout, constraints (SDC, Clocks, CDC, RDC), Static timing analysis, Low-power, and Power-aware flows (UPF)
Prior experience in VLSI CAD methodology and tool development
Good understanding of HDL: System Verilog, Verilog, VHDL, front-end design, physical design and layout implementation/generation flows and tools
Understanding or prior experience with EDA tools for design, verification, DFT and implementation
Experience with Design revision control (GIT, DesignSync) and Make
Splunk, Jenkins, LSF and CI/CD process

Job location:

San Diego, CA

The base salary range for this position is as mentioned below per year. We also provide competitive benefits, incentive compensation, and/or equity for certain roles.

Company benefits include health. dental, and vision insurance. 401(k), and paid leave. Please note that the base salary range (OR hourly rate) is a guideline, and individual total compensation may vary based on a number of factors such as qualifications, skill level, work location, and other business and organizational needs. This base pay range is specific to California and is not applicable to other locations. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range as of the date of this posting is:

$147,900 to $203,400 annually

Role Overview

This position is for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join a team focused on developing end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous vehicles. The team is responsible for converting petabytes of multi-modal fleet data into high-quality, semantically rich training datasets. This role will own the dataset layer that these advanced models learn from, playing a part in the data flywheel that includes mining failure cases, auto-labeling at scale, and validating data quality.

Design, implement, test, and deploy cloud-based pipelines to convert logged multi-sensor data into VLM/VLA training datasets.
Develop open-vocabulary detection, dense captioning, and semantic enrichment using foundation models to scale annotation.
Produce language-grounded reasoning and chain-of-causation style annotations to support VLA training.
Surface rare, difficult, and high-uncertainty scenarios to build curated datasets that improve downstream model metrics.
Define dataset schemas, quality metrics, and validation processes, tracking auto-labeling quality against model requirements.
Partner with VLM/VLA model developers to define dataset specifications and operationalize a continuous delivery loop.
Build distributed, reproducible pipelines using columnar data formats and distributed compute.
Serve as a project lead, mentor engineers, conduct design reviews, and set coding and annotation standards.
Track advances in multimodal models, auto-labeling, and end-to-end autonomous driving to apply relevant research.

Education:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field with competences typically acquired through 6+ years of experience, or a Master’s Degree in a related technical field with competences typically acquired through 3+ years of experience.

Experience:
Must be highly skilled and proficient, able to conduct complex work under minimal supervision. Expected to drive alignment across team interfaces, own technical solutions, and mentor other engineers.

A combination of the following skills is required:

Computer Vision & Deep Learning: Model training and expertise in at least two of the following: 2D/3D Object Detection, Tracking, Sensor Fusion, Semantic Segmentation, BEV, or Depth Estimation.
Multimodal / VLM Experience: Hands-on work with vision-language models, open-vocabulary recognition, dense captioning, or semantic search applied to perception data.

Distributed ML & Data Frameworks: Experience with PyTorch, Lightning, Ray, Spark, or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with VLM/VLA or end-to-end driving models and reasoning-trace datasets.
Experience with auto-labeling foundation models for annotation and verification.
Knowledge of high-throughput model serving frameworks like vLLM or SGLang.
Experience with semantic inference, retrieval, and vector databases such as LanceDB.
Familiarity with AV data standards (e.g., Pegasus layers) and robotics formats (e.g., ROS bags, MCAP).
Proficiency in cloud development and orchestration, including Terraform and AWS managed services.
Experience with data visualization tools like Foxglove or FiftyOne.
Contributions to closed-loop/open-loop evaluation frameworks or publications in top-tier AI/Robotics venues.

Onboard Autonomy models to execute replay/recompute workflows and subsequent metric evaluation.

Become a domain expert on partner team models, such as Camera, Lidar, Vehicle Intent, or Object Tracking, to implement and own integrations.

Five or more years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science platforms, or DevOps delivery.

Experience with automated testing, deployment validation, environment management, monitoring, and production support.

Experience supporting energy market analytics, forecasting, optimization, trading, utility, or renewable energy platforms.
Familiarity with wholesale power markets, generation operations, transmission systems, or energy trading processes.
Experience working with market, operational, forecasting, or asset-performance datasets in the energy industry.

Experience with cloud analytics, reporting, visualization, semantic-layer, machine learning, or optimization solutions.

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

The Opportunity

The Lead Development Product Owner – AI Product Solutions
selected for this position will join AI enablement teams in USAA’s Technology organization.  The candidate will have an opportunity to support a value chain of AI delivery that runs from pilots through production.  The candidate selected for this position will be responsible for serving several AI domains and partnering with peers to manage dependencies and risks across the wider AI value chain. This includes working with multiple delivery teams and stakeholders through all stages of the development lifecycle. 

The candidate selected for this position will be accountable for attaining, understanding, and communicating business needs to manage backlogs of work including guiding teams of Data Scientist and AI Engineers in writing and refining features and stories, planning and prioritizing work, and managing risks to delivery plans. The candidate will also be responsible for ensuring development work adheres to applicable internal software development lifecycle controls. The candidate will demonstrate strong critical thinking, problem solving, and technical knowledge along with an expert ability to work across multiple delivery methodologies to plan and predictably deliver business value.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.

Coaches and mentors less experienced Product Owners, including Seniors.
Demonstrates expert knowledge in multiple business or system domains and capable of leading development across multiple teams at the program level.
Identifies engages, influences and leads business stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts across programs.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.

5 or more years of experience in enterprise technology, Data Science, or AI/ML product/program management at a major financial institution.
5 or more years of experience managing delivery team backlog and workflow in systems of record such as JIRA and Clarity.

US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner

updated.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Staff AI Platform Engineer to build the shared platform that lets people across the company build and run AI-powered tools safely and quickly. As a hands-on senior individual contributor, you will help design the application runtime, knowledge systems, agent infrastructure, and governance tooling that teams would otherwise build separately, and you will help set the patterns other engineers follow. Your work spans product R&D, design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis. It draws on data from our battery test stands, factory manufacturing robots, and deployed projects in the field, along with the documents, slide decks, transcripts, and conversations our teams produce every day. You will sit on the AI & Data Platform team, working with data engineers, software engineers, Information Security, and the scientists, engineers, and operators who use what you build. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission puts AI to work.

This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from our office in Berkeley, CA, Somerville, MA or Weirton, WV 3+ days per week.

Relocation assistance is available.

What You'll Do

Build and operate the internal application platform that lets employees create and deploy AI-generated applications on curated backend and frontend frameworks, with starter templates, design guidance, authentication, and secure deployment built in, so app authors own only business logic, user flows, and UI.
Give those applications governed access to data, including connectivity to our data warehouse and a shared Postgres cluster for application state that is automatically integrated into our data platform.
Build and operate a central knowledge platform over unstructured content (documents, slide decks, meeting transcripts, Slack) and structured data from battery test stands, manufacturing robots, and deployed systems, pairing document retrieval with query access to structured data through semantic models and text-to-SQL. Own its retrieval quality through semantic and hybrid search, re-ranking, chunking, and classification, with source-level permissions and evaluation sets that show whether a change helps.
Design and deploy the shared MCP infrastructure, including a gateway layer (such as agentgateway) for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging, and build MCP servers for applications and services across the software org and for selected external tools.
Own model selection and cost: evaluate open-source and open-weight models against frontier models on our own tasks, decide where each fits, and reduce token usage through context management, caching, and model routing.
Build the agent orchestration layer, including multi-agent workflows and long-running loops with checkpoints, human review gates, and automated evaluation. Work with data engineers to decide when work should run as a deterministic, scheduled workflow and when it needs a graph or state machine in which an agent chooses among bounded steps.
Partner with product R&D, battery design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis teams to find repeatable work and automate it, including agent workflows whose output informs critical design and process decisions.
Instrument the platform with tracing, evaluation, and usage and cost attribution by team, and stand up the AWS infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi and/or Terraform) it runs on.
Help stand up a company-wide skills and plugin marketplace that vets contributions against AI policy and scans them for security vulnerabilities with open-source and commercial tools. Advise on AI governance, recommending changes that make the policy specific to platform needs and automating its execution, such as approvals for new tools.
